promptBrief: 方向 A「控制台」：功能主义扁平 UI，游戏适配设置页 + 语音输入悬浮窗，无立绘无纹理
generationPrompt:
WEB PAGE SECTION DESIGN — this must look like a REAL rendered desktop application screenshot, NOT a poster, NOT an illustration.
The image should look exactly like what you'd see if you opened a beautifully designed dark-mode desktop voice-input app for gamers.

Section type: desktop app UI direction board — one settings window plus one floating voice-input widget, shown together on a dark canvas
Design style: functionalist tool aesthetic — restrained, clean, efficient flat design; no textures; glow minimal to none; rigorous information alignment; anime-brand colors applied to a pure utility interface.

CONTENT (render as real readable UI text in Chinese, NOT as decorative lettering):
一个深色（#1A1A2E）桌面设置窗口界面：
- 左侧窄导航栏，顶部一个 Kotone 小圆形头像 logo，导航项自上而下：通用 / 快捷键 / 引擎与模型 / 游戏适配 / 历史记录 / 关于，当前激活项为「游戏适配」（细青色高亮指示条）
- 右侧内容区为「游戏适配」设置页：游戏列表卡片（League of Legends、Valorant、Apex Legends、原神，每张卡片带游戏图标与开关 toggle），以及选中游戏的发送快捷键配置区（显示 Ctrl+Enter 的快捷键输入框、「聊天框模式」下拉选择框、品红色「测试发送」按钮）
设置窗口旁边一个语音输入悬浮窗：
- 纯青色 #00E5FF 声波波形
- 一行识别文字「对面打野在下路草丛，准备来抓」
- 右下角一个品红 #FF2D78 圆形发送按钮

CHARACTER: no character illustration anywhere in this interface. The only character presence is the tiny circular Kotone avatar logo at the top of the left navigation rail — derive its likeness from the reference image. Everything else is pure utility UI.

TEXTURE: completely flat solid-color surfaces; no background texture, no patterns, no gradients on panels.

COLOR PALETTE: base #1A1A2E deep blue-black, accent #00E5FF neon cyan, #FF2D78 magenta reserved strictly for key CTA elements (测试发送 button, circular send button), #7B2FFF purple used only very sparingly. Backgrounds, accents, text colors and button colors all derive from this palette.

VISUAL LANGUAGE: flat modern desktop UI, strict 8px spacing grid, precise alignment, small border radius, 1px hairline dividers, clean sans-serif typography with clear h1 > h2 > body > caption hierarchy, crisp toggle switches and dropdown controls. Almost no glow — at most a very faint cyan indicator on the active nav item.

CRITICAL RULES:
- This must look like a PIXEL-PERFECT application render, with proper CSS-like layout: flexbox alignment, grid spacing, consistent padding
- All text must be SHARP, READABLE, and properly typeset — Chinese UI text rendered accurately, like real app typography, not poster lettering
- The tiny avatar art must match cel-shaded anime style, consistent with the reference
- Include realistic UI elements: navigation rail, toggle switches, dropdown, input field, buttons, cards, icons, dividers, badges as appropriate for a settings window
- The overall composition should be balanced and professional
- Do NOT add an OS title bar, OS window chrome, watermark, "mockup" label, or "design by" credit around the design
- The image IS the app screen — edge to edge, no frame, no margin
- OUTPUT MUST LOOK LIKE A REAL APPLICATION SCREENSHOT — not a poster, not an illustration
- Texture is absent by design; surfaces stay flat
